attributes.action: Give students the Monday off after the 1am match so we can rest and focus
attributes.additional_details: We call on the UK government to grant all students the following Monday off school after the England World Cup match at 1 a.m. on Sunday. Many students will only get a few hours of sleep due to the late game, and this impacts their well-being, concentration, and ability to learn effectively the next day
attributes.background: We call on the UK government to give all students the following Monday off after the England World Cup match, which is at 1 a.m. on Sunday. With a very early school start, students will get minimal sleep, and this day off will help them recover and stay focused in class.

rejection.details: When our team got to your petition in the petitions queue, the date of the England vs Mexico World Cup game had already passed.
